scenario: After a short encounter with the police, a man fined for jaywalking wants to organise a foundation for young victims of crime. I am the president of the agency who decides about the foundation. The founder would donate 125,000 dollars to the foundation. However, he asks that the foundation would be named after himself, helping clear his name. The person who reported him for jaywalking opposes such a foundation and considers it highly upsetting. If I accept the donation that requires the foundation to be named after the jaywalker, crime victims will benefit from the 125,000 dollars. If I do not do this, the money will be lost.
entities: i,the man fined for jaywalking who wants to found and name the foundation after himself,the person who reported him for jaywalking,1+ young victims of crime who would be supported by the foundation,1+ police officers involved in the jaywalking encounter
outcomes: Young victims of crime do not receive support from the 125,000 dollars
The founder does not get a foundation named after himself
The founder's name is not helped by the foundation
The person who reported the jaywalking is not upset by such a foundation
